_comment: GET /api/v1/auth/sessions (AuthEndpoints.cs:60, GetOwnSessions :1125), the signed-in account's own active sessions. Body: a JSON array of UserSessionDto (AuthEndpoints.cs:1440), camelCase. ONE field is new: lastActivityAt. Every other field is unchanged. isCurrentSession is true on the row whose token id the refresh_token cookie names (TryGetCurrentTokenIdAsync, AuthEndpoints.cs:1192); the cookie reaches this route because RefreshTokenCookie.Path is /api/v1/auth (RefreshTokenCookie.cs:9). With no cookie (an API client), every row is false. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate). Both serializers drop null members by default (ApiJsonContext.cs:723-726 and Program.cs:1454, WhenWritingNull), so userAgent and ipAddress carry JsonIgnoreCondition.Never and every row has all seven keys (C5, spec audit F1 of the host, 2026-11-01).

fields.userAgent: string|null, unchanged type; a null is written as null, never omitted (contract choice C5)
fields.ipAddress: string|null, unchanged type; a null is written as null, never omitted (contract choice C5)
fields.lastActivityAt: ISO-8601 date-time, NEW, never null: RefreshToken.LastActivityAt (Identity/RefreshToken.cs:11), or createdAt when it holds the default value, as the profile twin maps it today (ProfileSessionsEndpoints.cs:52)

body.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0 Safari/537.36
